title: A fixed-particle halting detector with time-square-integrable fluid derivatives
exact_target: For every fixed positive computable viscosity, can each machine and finite input be effectively assigned smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$ with a unique global classical viscous flow so that every mixed derivative of force and velocity has time-dependent supremum norm in both $L_infinity(0,infinity)$ and L2(0,infinity), while a particle from a fixed initial label enters a fixed open strip exactly on halting? A divergence-free force may be required with the same velocity.
